communication.condition: {{headers.`X-Publishly-Signature` == 't=' + headers.`X-Publishly-Timestamp` + ',v1=' + sha256(headers.`X-Publishly-Timestamp` + '.' + createJSON(body), 'hex', parameters.signingSecret) && abs(parseNumber(formatDate(now, 'X')) - parseNumber(headers.`X-Publishly-Timestamp`)) <= 300 && headers.`X-Publishly-Event-Id` == body.id && headers.`X-Publishly-Event` == body.type}}
